import ctypes, errno, os
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
libc.prctl.argtypes=[ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_ulong,ctypes.c_ulong,ctypes.c_ulong,ctypes.c_ulong]
libc.prctl.restype=ctypes.c_int
def prctl(*a):
    r=libc.prctl(*(list(a)+[0]*(5-len(a))))
    if r!=0:
        e=ctypes.get_errno(); raise OSError(e, os.strerror(e))
    return r
try:
    print("subreaper", prctl(36,1))
except OSError as e: print("subreaper fail", e)
class Filter(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[("code",ctypes.c_ushort),("jt",ctypes.c_ubyte),("jf",ctypes.c_ubyte),("value",ctypes.c_uint32)]
class Program(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[("length",ctypes.c_ushort),("filters",ctypes.POINTER(Filter))]
instructions=[(0x20,0,0,4),(0x15,1,0,0xc000003e),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000),(0x20,0,0,0),(0x35,0,1,0x40000000),(0x06,0,0,0x80000000)]
for number in (62,200,234,112,109):
    instructions.extend([(0x15,0,1,number),(0x06,0,0,0x00050000|errno.EPERM)])
instructions.append((0x06,0,0,0x7fff0000))
filters=(Filter*len(instructions))(*(Filter(*i) for i in instructions))
program=Program(len(instructions),filters)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
    try:
        prctl(38,1)
        prctl(22,2,ctypes.cast(ctypes.pointer(program),ctypes.c_void_p).value)
        os._exit(0)
    except OSError as e:
        print("child filter fail",e)
        os._exit(3)
print("child status", os.waitpid(pid,0)[1]>>8)
